evidence_chain.phase364_scale_method: Round3 used only as accepted MECHANISM reference; recognizable Round3 sentences were deliberately not copied.

diagnosis.invalid_inference: A human-accepted short-form prose surface can be reduced to abstract mechanisms and later regenerated at long-form scale without material quality loss.
diagnosis.observed_failure: The exact prose surface that created reader pull was not preserved. Long-form regeneration satisfied increasingly explicit mechanisms and structural checks while losing the human-approved reading effect.
diagnosis.engineering_consequence: Mechanism compliance is not sufficient evidence of prose-surface continuity.
